card.name: Words before care or requirement instructions
card.fires_on: Small linking words, commas or the word care just before an instruction about what is needed or must be done. Seen in overdosage sections (patient must <<be>> monitored, supportive <<care>>) and in plant-care or advice text.

card.writes: It seems to push toward words meaning to ensure or guarantee, suggesting a coming statement of what is required or assured.
card.plain: It fires on the small word right before a sentence says what must be done or provided, such as monitoring after an overdose or care for plants.
